title: [Bug]: Can't provide images to Gemini models
body:
### Bug Description

I create a ChatMessage with one text and multiple image blocks but only the text block is provided to Gemini.

The problem is during the message conversion:
https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/v0.12.19/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-vertex/llama_index/llms/vertex/base.py#L228

This leads to:
https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/v0.12.19/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-vertex/llama_index/llms/vertex/gemini_utils.py#L56

Here the message content is used but that is a legacy solution that returns only the text content of the message.
The blocks field should be used here:

https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/v0.12.19/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/base/llms/types.py#L177

In the _convert_gemini_part_to_prompt method there is code to handle images but as far as I can tell this method is only called with string input so that code is never executed.



### Version

v0.12.19

### Steps to Reproduce

Create a ChatMessage with a text block and an image block.
Create a Vertex LLM.
Call the chat method on the llm with the chat message and check what is provided for the LLM.

linked_prs.body:
# Description

This PR fixes #17882 by updating the `convert_chat_message_to_gemini_content` function in the Vertex AI integration enabling support for `TextBlock` and `ImageBlock` objects. Previously, images in `ChatMessage` blocks were ignored because the function relied solely on `content`. Now, it handles `TextBlock` with text validation and `ImageBlock` with `path`, `image`, or `url` inputs, ensuring images are passed to Vertex AI correctly. New test cases validate single and multiple `TextBlock`s, empty `TextBlock` errors, and invalid `ImageBlock` errors. Documentation is updated to reflect this block-based API for Gemini vision models.

**Motivation**: The change addresses a reported issue where Vertex AI couldn’t process images in messages, improving compatibility with multi-modal inputs.

**Context**: This update aligns the Vertex AI integration with `llama-index`’s block-based message structure, enhancing its functionality for Gemini models.

**Dependencies**: No new external dependencies are required; relies on existing `vertexai` and `llama-index` libraries.

Fixes #17882
